connector.name: Ibanforge
connector.registryDescription: Pre-payout IBAN screening for AI agents: validation, sanctions (OFAC), Swiss clearing, risk
connector.summary: Hosted at api.ibanforge.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package ibanforge-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cammac-creator account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IBANFORGE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Bearer ifk_* API key (free tier 200 req/month).

env.name: IBANFORGE_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://api.ibanforge.com).
